description: This PHP class 'LeaveDetailedModel' defines a data model for serializing detailed leave information in an HR management system. It implements the 'Normalizable' interface and incorporates traits for date-time handling and normalization. The class constructs a structured array representation of detailed leave data, including dates, leave status, actions, balance, type, and comments, suitable for API responses.

classes.name: LeaveDetailedModel
classes.description: A model class for representing detailed leave information in a serializable format for API responses, including various leave attributes and comments.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a DetailedLeave object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the detailed leave data into an associative array suitable for serialization, including dates, status, actions, balance, type, and comments.
